name: Diputación Foral de Álava (Araba)
verdict: The Araba/Álava logo promotes the province of Álava, whose foral government, the Diputación Foral de Álava, sponsors Deportivo Alavés to promote the territory. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Spanish provincial (foral) public body - state ownership alone is not a tier; no record of serious abuses found. Same treatment as Sabor a Málaga.
